text:
aj: Kicking off a partner benchmark thread for Aerochip listing + SI reference. High level ask: show perf/W and sustained throughput for their AC-XL family and provide a repeatable runbook.
Maya: Thanks. Aerochip asked for a short, reproducible artifact set for marketplace consumption and a longer tech appendix for SIs.
Aerochip-eng: aerochip-eng: We can support Feb 14

18 for lab access (thermal chamber available on the 15th). We'll provide three evaluation boards and a telemetry agent that emits per-GPU power, fan RPM, and board temps at 2s intervals.
kevin: Need to lock down kernel version (we prefer 6.4.x for our runtime) and exact module versions. Also plan to run with SMT off on the host for consistency.
Sophia: From product perspective: target p50 <= 120ms on batch=1 for 4k seq, characterize perf/W across sequence lengths 2k/4k/8k, and show quant modes supported (FP16, int8-ptq).
Dmitri: Add accuracy gating: compute exact BLEU and ROUGE-L on the eval set. For int8-ptq, fail if ROUGE-L drop > 1.5 percentage points vs FP16 baseline.
aj: Can we schedule a dry-run before the lab window?
Aerochip-eng: Yes, we can do a remote smoke the week before (Feb 10) using one board.
Maya: Runbook scope: 1) hardware inventory + firmware hashes, 2) kernel + modprobe snapshot, 3) bench command and config, 4) telemetry archive + checksums, 5) analysis notebook and marketplace-ready PNGs.
kevin: I'll draft the kernel snapshot script. Example snippet to capture env: 
```bash
uname -r > /tmp/bench-env.txt
dpkg -l linux-image-* | tail -n 1 >> /tmp/bench-env.txt
for m in nvgpu nvhost nvswitch; do lsmod | grep $m || true; done >> /tmp/bench-env.txt
```
Sophia: For marketplace tiles we need simple numbers: tokens/sec @ key seqs, perf/W at peak throughput, and a note on validated quant modes. Keep figure captions short.
Dmitri: Telemetry format: CSV with header [ts,gpu_id,power_w,board_temp_c,fan_rpm,kv_cache_hits]. We will accept 2s sampling but prefer 1s if possible. Include UTC timestamps.
aj: Where do artifacts land?
Aerochip-eng: We'll push raw telemetry and firmware images to s3://acxlab-public/aerochip-redwood/feb-run-raw/ and grant a read-only role.
Maya: Marketing/legal note: partner wants a co-branded "Aerochip-Validated" badge. Legal needs to approve copy and logo usage. I'll loop in legal.
release-bot: release-bot: Created checklist at /releases/partners/aerochip-1807654321/checklist  items: runbook PR, telemetry archive, analysis notebook, marketing assets, legal consent, SI appendix.
kevin: Tuning plan: IRQ pinning to CPUs 4-11, isolate cpus 12-15 for runtime, increase irqbalance off, set vm.swappiness=10. I'll push a dedicated branch kevin/aerochip-tuning.
Sophia: We'll also include a short Terraform example for SI deployment: optimized kernel module install, runtime container, and autoscaling policy recommendations (scale step at 70% sustained CPU or GPU util).
Dmitri: Reporting schema (one-line): model, sku, seq_len, batch, tokens_per_sec, avg_power_w, perf_per_w, p50_ms, p95_ms, quant_mode, accuracy_delta. CSV + single summary.json expected.
aj: Failure conditions: if any p50 exceeds 2x baseline or int8 accuracy delta > 1.5 pts, mark run as degraded and capture debug logs.
kevin: Debug collection snippet: 
```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/debug && cp /var/log/syslog /tmp/debug/syslog && perf record -o /tmp/debug/perf.data -a sleep 30
tar czf /tmp/debug-$(date +%s).tgz /tmp/debug
```
Sophia: Pre-run smoke: run one full workload at 10% of steps in pre-prod to validate infra. We also want token-level latency dump to correlate spikes to KV cache misses.
Aerochip-eng: We can enable token-level telemetry on request and will keep logs for 7 days.
Maya: Timeline proposal: Feb 10 remote smoke; Feb 14 dropboard + kernel tuning; Feb 15 thermal perf sweep; Feb 16 quant and accuracy; Feb 17 analysis + draft marketplace artifacts; Feb 18 final review + handoff to marketing.
aj: Action owners: kevin (kernel/tuning + scripts), sophia (eval set + marketplace text), dmitri (quant harness + analysis schema), maya (runbook + legal/marketing coordination), aerochip-eng (lab + telemetry + firmware).
kevin: Pushing initial script: https://stash.redwood.ai/kevin/aerochip-tuning/commit/7f9e
Maya: I'll open the runbook PR under partner-benchmarks and tag this thread.
release-bot: release-bot: Reminder: schedule post-run write-up meeting for Feb 20 if artifacts look good.
aj: Thanks all. Please keep replies brief and tag blockers. :white_check_mark:
